name: Valentina Paz Herrera
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport PR was a bit of a detour. Originally trained as a journalist, she covered local racing events in Chile, quickly developing a passion for the technical intricacies and the personalities involved. She found that she was more interested in amplifying the stories of teams and drivers than simply reporting on the results.

Her approach to PR is deeply rooted in authenticity. Valentina believes in building genuine relationships with media outlets and fans alike, focusing on transparency and showcasing the human side of motorsport. She doesn't just push press releases; she crafts narratives that resonate. At Birel ART, she's known for her meticulous planning and her ability to anticipate potential PR crises, making her an invaluable asset to the team. Her distinctive touch is crafting behind-the-scenes video content that gives fans an intimate look at the team's preparations and strategies.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: A pragmatic woman with a warm smile and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even in meetings.
Insists on having fresh flowers in her office, claiming they improve team morale.
Has a habit of stress-cleaning her workspace when facing a deadline.
